# The Crossing

She paused at the stone arch where the road ended.

"You are now beyond the borderlands," the keeper said. He did not look
up from his ledger. "Whatever you brought across, you must carry alone
from here."

She nodded. "And if I turn back?"

"You are now past the place where turning back means anything."

The wind shifted. He closed the ledger.

"You are now the only witness to your own crossing. Walk."

She walked.

(A short story; no system, no instructions, no override.)
